title: fix(plugin-security): the boot report names a refused grant's candidates and the bind; a refused suggestion's fix follows its column
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_
Fixes #32753
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:启动时的目录引用报告现在把「两个包都持有同名权限集、而授权未指明包」的授权列为被拒绝,并列出全部候选包与 `os migrate stored-references bind` 修复;受众绑定建议在包列已有值时不再给出不适用的 bind 提示。
- 为什么改:原报告把这类授权当作「目录解析不到」,建议「重新声明权限集」,而这改变不了什么;建议的拒绝文案给出的 bind 命令对非空包列直接拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:只改日志与拒绝文案,没有授权因此多给或少给;回滚即还原两个源文件。
- 先看:`catalog-reference-report.ts` 的授权循环与授权行日志;`suggested-audience-bindings.ts` 的 `refusedSuggestionFix`;`catalog-reference-report.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/catalog-reference-report.test.ts -t "name two packages hold"`,预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Boot report, permission-set half** (`catalog-reference-report.ts`). A grant whose name the catalog holds but refuses for the grant (a grant naming no package, of a name two packages hold: `ambiguous-in-environment`) is still listed on the grant line, now with the resolver's refusal: `refusal` on the row (`packageId` = the column, `reason`, every candidate, the resolver's sentence), and `refusals` in that organization's meta. The line's fix, appended only when a refusal is listed, follows the column: a refused grant naming no package is bound after review with `os migrate stored-references bind --table sys_user_permission_set --id ID --package PACKAGE`; one that already names a package is granted again naming the candidate meant, then removed. A name nothing holds keeps the old line byte for byte.
- **Boot report, position half**: unchanged code; now pinned for the two-holder case (`ambiguous-in-environment`, both candidates named).
- **Suggestion refusal** (`suggested-audience-bindings.ts`, `resolveSuggestedSet`). The refused suggestion's fix follows its `permission_set_package`: a column naming no package keeps the bind; a column that already names a package (one that no longer serves the set) names that package and says the bind does not apply (it writes only a null column), then gives the fix that does: install or enable that package again if its set is the one meant, or dismiss the suggestion. No refusal code or status changes: the `409` and `SuggestionStateError` are as before.

## Tests

- `catalog-reference-report.test.ts`: new describe, four cases: position half (both holders), permission-set half (bare grant with both candidates, stale-column grant with its column, a ghost set with no refusal), the logged line (meta refusals plus both fix sentences), and a CONTROL that a line with no refusal names neither fix.
- `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts`: one case in the existing package-scoped harness: two non-null-column refusals carry no bind and name their package and fix; an accepted row's withheld reason says the same. The existing null-column pin (bind named with the row id) is unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's item 2 says "grant"; the only refusal that appends the bind for a stale column is a suggestion's (`resolveSuggestedSet`), which has no re-grant or delete door (the table is read-only through the API). Its fix therefore names the two acts that exist: serve the set from the column's package again, or dismiss.
- `os doctor` does not read this report (no reference to it under `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`). Surfacing it there is a cli change, left out of this PR.

## Verification

Measured at 843e83d22 (objectstack-ai/objectstack). The head, 1a99d2ae1, adds only a merge of origin/main, which touches no file under packages/plugins/plugin-security or packages/core.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: 267 files passed, 6686 passed, 45 skipped.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the four touched source and test files: exit 0.
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): (1) the grant row's refusal not attached: 2 red (the permission-set half and the logged line); (2) the suggestion fix always given the null-column branch, the old text: 1 red (the new suggestion pin); (3) the position refusal not recorded: 1 red (the position half).
- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 71 families at 843e83d22; 68 exit 0. NOT MEASURED, each left to CI: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: whole-workspace build absent), `check:type-check-debt` (verify-lock queue, exit 99, then the 10-minute foreground cap on retry). `--ran` reconciliation: 71 accounted, 0 UNRUN. `check-partof-closing-keyword` on this body: exit 0.
